latin: Ideo dixit Socrates in Cratylo se somniare circa ideas, quia ideis non utimur in hoc statu, sed earum imaginibus proximis uel secundariis.
translation: Socrates said in the Cratylus that he was dreaming about the Ideas for this reason: that in this state we do not make use of the Ideas themselves, but of their proximate or secondary images.
